content.description: Mintable was founded in 2018 by Zach Burks and is an NFT marketplace built on Ethereum. Users can bid on, create, distribute, buy, sell, and trade NFTs. Developers can use the Mintable NFT API to fetch and return NFT information for Mintable. Upon purchasing, both the seller and buyer wallets are credited with a MINT token, incentivising usage of the platform.
